scope: Fresh checks. Fixtures do not establish live provider semantics. Native journey failed separately.

gates.limitation: Existing main JS chunk over 500 kB.
Existing theme font proof advisories; built-only scan does not inspect JSX conventions.

steps: New tree (Tab, Enter) → name field; Enter creates the tree; focus moves to Start conversation on the empty map
Start conversation (Enter) focuses the composer; Enter sends; the first reply creates the root node
Select passage in tutor reply 1 (Enter) → read-only text; Home/Arrow/Shift+Arrow select the repeated passage; Tab → Ask about selection; edited question; Create focused chat saves exact offsets 19–30
The same keys create a nested child from the child reply; composer focused in the new chat
IME composition, committed CJK text and Arrow/Home/End/Space/Backspace in the composer never move the map
Model for next reply (Space/Enter) opens the menu; Escape closes only the menu and restores focus to its trigger; Home/ArrowDown/Enter saves Keyboard B for this conversation only
During a reply the model menu is disabled and the turn uses its captured model; Shift+Tab → Stop, Enter interrupts the reply
Expand chat / Show map beside chat toggle by Enter and keep focus on the toggle
Escape returns from chat to the map; focus lands on "Open What is sugar?" in the map
Tree canvas region: Arrow pans 100px, Shift+Arrow 300px
A focused conversation box moves with Arrow (10px) and Shift+Arrow (100px); the move is announced
Zoom in, Zoom out and Fit tree are toolbar buttons operated with Enter
Collapse/Expand descendants toggle with Enter/Space and keep focus on the toggle
Map menu (Enter, ArrowDown, Enter): Collapse all, Expand all and Keep current branch
Enter on a box title opens its chat with the composer focused; Escape returns focus to that title
Reveal source passage (Enter) focuses the exact highlighted passage; Escape returns to the reveal control
No keyboard trap: 60 Tabs from "Reveal source passage for Why trade water?" visited 20 distinct controls; Shift+Tab returns to the start
